arguments.query:
WITH fees_nx AS (
  SELECT ID, fixed_amount, rate, aci
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE card_scheme = 'NexPay' AND is_credit = TRUE
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT f.ID, a AS aci, f.fixed_amount + f.rate * 10 / 10000 AS fee_10eur
  FROM fees_nx f, UNNEST(f.aci) AS a
)
SELECT aci, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, ROUND(AVG(fee_10eur), 4) AS avg_fee, ROUND(MAX(fee_10eur), 4) AS max_fee
FROM exploded
GROUP BY aci
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC, aci ASC
